Choose the best answer for each question.

**1.** In GitHub, after a branch has been merged into `main`, what should you do with the merged branch?

A) Merge it a second time
B) Turn it into a new repository
C) Rename it `main`
D) Delete it

**2.** In GitHub, what is the `main` branch?

A) A temporary experiment
B) The official, working version
C) A branch only collaborators can see
D) A branch that is deleted after every commit

**3.** In the Bash shell, you are in `/Users/calvinw`. Which command moves you into the `projects` directory?

A) `ls projects`
B) `pwd projects`
C) `cd projects`
D) `projects cd`

**4.** What is the first step in creating a new repository on GitHub?

A) Select Add a README file
B) Sign in to GitHub and click New repository
C) Open the Actions tab
D) Create a branch named main

**5.** In the Bash command line, what does `pwd` stand for?

A) print web directory
B) print working directory
C) previous working directory
D) path with directories

**6.** In GitHub, how do you add a collaborator to a repository?

A) Open the Actions tab and select Pages
B) Click the Commits label above the list of files
C) Click the pencil icon on `README.md`
D) Open Settings, then select Collaborators under Access

**7.** In app design and vibe coding, what is Stitch?

A) A version tracking tool
B) A shell for typing commands
C) A hosting service for websites
D) An AI design tool for apps and webpages

**8.** When do changes to `index.html` appear on the published GitHub Pages website?

A) After they are committed to the publishing branch
B) As soon as you type them
C) Only after you delete the repository
D) Only after you create a codespace

**9.** How do you prompt a multimodal LLM (large language model) using audio?

A) Type the prompt into the terminal
B) Commit an audio file to `main`
C) Speak into a microphone on your computer
D) Press Enter in Bash

**10.** In the Bash shell, you run `cd projects` from `/Users/calvinw` and then run `pwd`. What does `pwd` print?

A) `/Users/calvinw`
B) `/Users/calvinw/projects`
C) `about.html  index.html  style.css`
D) Nothing

**11.** Who can see the files in a public GitHub repository?

A) Only the owner and collaborators
B) Anyone on the internet
C) Only people who have a codespace
D) Only people who accepted an invitation

**12.** In an AI chat, what does the reasoning model, the DeepThink button, show you?

A) A list of collaborators
B) The repository's commit history
C) Only the final answer
D) Its thinking process

**13.** What made DeepSeek different from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini?

A) It is the only model that accepts images
B) It was released as an open source model that anyone can download and run
C) It cannot write code
D) It is made by Anthropic

**14.** Which of these is a vibe coding tool for building apps with an LLM?

A) Lovable
B) Bash
C) GitHub Pages
D) Markdown

**15.** In GitHub, why would you create a new branch?

A) To make the repository public
B) To invite a collaborator
C) To publish a website
D) To make changes without changing `main`

**16.** In vibe coding, what can Stitch generate or export for pages and screens?

A) A Git repository
B) HTML prototypes
C) A DoltHub database
D) A terminal session

**17.** In the Bash command line used in this lesson, the prompt is `#`. What does the prompt mean?

A) An error occurred
B) The command was deleted
C) The shell is waiting for a command
D) The file is a comment

**18.** In GitHub, when the work on a branch is ready, what do you do to bring it into the official version?

A) Delete `main`
B) Merge the branch into `main`
C) Make the repository private
D) Create a codespace

**19.** What does GitHub Pages do?

A) Tracks the commit history of a file
B) Lets collaborators chat with each other
C) Publishes a repository as a free website
D) Creates a codespace for you

**20.** In GitHub, what is a branch?

A) A permanent copy of the repository on your laptop
B) A type of file
C) A separate version of the repository
D) A person who works on the repository

**21.** What is it sometimes called when an LLM (large language model) can call tools, which are external programs?

A) Agentic
B) Multimodal
C) Open source
D) Proprietary

**22.** Which item that vibe coding usually leaves out is about user identity verification and access control?

A) Publishing
B) Version tracking
C) Database
D) Authentication

**23.** In GitHub, how can you confirm which branch you are working on?

A) The branch menu shows the current branch
B) The title of the README
C) The Collaborators page
D) The Actions tab

**24.** In the Bash command line, which command lists the files and directories in the current folder?

A) `ls`
B) `pwd`
C) `cd`
D) `bash`

**25.** In software development with AI, what is vibe coding?

A) Writing every line of code by hand
B) Publishing a website with GitHub Pages
C) Coding with an LLM but letting the AI do all the work
D) Typing commands into a terminal
